declarations: Show the Horizon logo at startup

known_scope_gaps.launcher-settings: Pinned settings storage, Settings card and CLI declarations are indexed. Nested launcher dialogs, other pages, and detailed equivalence to Builder and the UWP shell need a fuller crosswalk.
known_scope_gaps.create-world-settings: Stock create-world controls and declared game rules are listed. Datapack-defined choices, separate dedicated server configuration and service settings require additional coverage.
known_scope_gaps.runtime-registered-controls: The finite source inventory covers control types and shipped native packs; installed mods, classic packs and hardware-dependent choices supply additional values at runtime.
known_scope_gaps.settings-metadata: Unresolved field-level behavior, exact ranges and controls are listed by record ID.
known_scope_gaps.hardware-matrix: Physical acceptance requires the exact signed version, negotiated device/profile, active route and exercised values.
